subject: why does cfa in lavaan not follow my restrictions in the formula?

messages.author: 9234afd3e4831350
messages.subject: why does cfa in lavaan not follow my restrictions in the formula?
parts:
Here is some code that reproduces my problem.

library(lavaan)
library(MASS)

N = 10000

random.seed(123)

cov = cbind(c(1, 0.5),c(0.5, 2))

S = mvrnorm(n=N, mu=c(0, 0), Sigma=cov)

f = S[,1] # latent
x = S[,2]  # observed

m1 = 2.5*f + 2*x + rnorm(sd=1, n=N)
m2 = 1*f + 3*x + rnorm(sd=2, n=N)
m3 = 3*f + 0*x + rnorm(sd=3, n=N)
m4 = -1*f - 3*x + rnorm(sd=1.5, n=N)
m5 = 3*f + 0*x + rnorm(sd=1, n=N)

df = data.frame(cbind(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, x))

cfa.model = '
fx =~ 1*x + m1 + m2 + m4
f =~ start(0.2)*m1 + m2 + m3 + m4 + m5
f ~~ 1*f
x ~~ 0*x
'

cfa.fit = cfa(cfa.model, data=df)
summary(cfa.fit)

And I get the following output.

lavaan 0.6-3 ended normally after 42 iterations

  Optimization method                           NLMINB
  Number of free parameters                         14

  Number of observations                         10000

  Estimator                                         ML
  Model Fit Test Statistic                   12981.132
  Degrees of freedom                                 7
  P-value (Chi-square)                           0.000

Parameter Estimates:

  Information                                 Expected
  Information saturated (h1) model          Structured
  Standard Errors                             Standard

Latent Variables:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
  fx =~                                               
    x                 1.000                           
    m1                2.574    0.017  151.882    0.000
    m2                3.004    0.016  193.108    0.000
    m4               -2.999    0.012 -248.564    0.000
  f =~                                                
    m1                0.200                           
    m2                0.964    0.024   40.452    0.000
    m3                2.785    0.041   68.193    0.000
    m4               -0.942    0.019  -49.192    0.000
    m5                2.968    0.029  102.700    0.000

Covariances:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
  fx ~~                                               
    f                 0.473    0.014   33.331    0.000

Variances:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
    f                 1.000                           
   .x                 0.000                           
   .m1                5.641    0.080   70.687    0.000
   .m2                3.988    0.058   68.786    0.000
   .m4                2.326    0.035   66.479    0.000
   .m3                9.702    0.169   57.448    0.000
   .m5                0.461    0.111    4.162    0.000
    fx                1.966    0.028   70.712    0.000


You can see that I told lavaan to start at a value of 0.2 for the loading on m1 for factor f. But it fixes it to this value, despite the fact that I've made sure to fix the value of the latent variable `f` to 1. To force lavaan to free up the loading, I could use option `std.lv=T`, but then I'd be forcing lavaan to give a standard deviation of 1 to the `fx` variable, which is observed, e.g., by setting the residual variance of `x` to 0. I'll do this below.

cfa.fit = cfa(cfa.model, data=df, std.lv=T)

And I get

lavaan 0.6-3 ended normally after 31 iterations

  Optimization method                           NLMINB
  Number of free parameters                         14

  Number of observations                         10000

  Estimator                                         ML
  Model Fit Test Statistic                    3246.232
  Degrees of freedom                                 7
  P-value (Chi-square)                           0.000

Parameter Estimates:

  Information                                 Expected
  Information saturated (h1) model          Structured
  Standard Errors                             Standard

Latent Variables:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
  fx =~                                               
    x                 1.000                           
    m1                1.996    0.013  148.556    0.000
    m2                2.993    0.021  143.055    0.000
    m4               -3.015    0.016 -191.758    0.000
  f =~                                                
    m1                2.436    0.021  115.946    0.000
    m2                0.971    0.022   43.349    0.000
    m3                2.930    0.037   78.715    0.000
    m4               -0.981    0.017  -56.638    0.000
    m5                2.893    0.024  122.332    0.000

Covariances:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
  fx ~~                                               
    f                 0.244    0.010   24.918    0.000

Variances:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
    f                 1.000                           
   .x                 0.000                           
   .m1                0.994    0.030   33.322    0.000
   .m2                3.994    0.057   69.647    0.000
   .m4                2.207    0.032   68.730    0.000
   .m3                8.937    0.135   66.279    0.000
   .m5                1.015    0.040   25.608    0.000
    fx                1.000

It appears I can recover most of the parameters with this restriction, except of course, the covariance between `fx` and `f` which should be 0.5. So perhaps the problem isn't too bad. But it would be nice if I could just use the former.

messages.subject: Re: why does cfa in lavaan not follow my restrictions in the formula?
parts:
Your syntax provides a start value for the m1 loading but does not explicitly declare it a free parameter. Try doing so by writing the line this way:

f =~ NA*m1 + start(0.2)*m1 + m2 + m3 + m4 + m5  

The NA says this parameter is free.
